synthetic_marker: All vectors are SYNTHETIC contract vectors for V02 (origin/PIT) and V07 (reconnect/window); no real market data.

two_year_old_backfill.scenario: first connect delivers bars whose event time is 2024-01 era; observed/available are 2026-09
expectations: every baseline bar row is acquisition_mode=SESSION_BACKFILL
observed_at_nano >= event_start_nano for every row (zero backdating)
first_observed_at_nano equals the earliest provable observation and is never rewritten

realtime_chain.scenario: in-formation bar observed PROVISIONAL, then CLOSED on the same connection_epoch/continuity_id with unbroken health
expectations: PROVISIONAL sighting verdict PROVISIONAL_OBSERVATION
CLOSED sighting acquisition_mode=REALTIME with verdict REALTIME_EVIDENCED
availability_basis LIVE_CAPTURE_EVIDENCE for every REALTIME-mode sighting (in-formation and closed)

reconnect_backfill.scenario: disconnect; reconnect (new epoch/continuity); bar that formed before the disconnect is seen CLOSED for the first time after reconnect
expectations: the post-reconnect CLOSED sighting is SESSION_BACKFILL
continuity_id changed across the disconnect (reset recorded)

synthetic_origin.expectation: SYNTHETIC sessions mark every envelope data_origin=SYNTHETIC with a prominent marker; SYNTHETIC never upgrades

duplicate_content.same_value: same K + same canonical content replays idempotently (COMMITTED_SAME_CONTENT, ACCEPTED)
duplicate_content.different_value: same K + different CLOSED content is CONFLICT: task QUARANTINED, conflict evidence emitted, default consumption blocked

disconnect_backoff.expectation: reconnect sleeps lie in [base, base*1.25]; after the ladder the connection-start budget (3 per rolling 600s) forces deferral instead of reconnect storms

expectations: pause honored conservatively (>= 60s)
two consecutive account rate limits stop new requests (remaining tasks DEFERRED_BUDGET)
circuit breaker: no further subscribe attempts after denial
task states PERMISSION_DENIED, run terminal FAILED
zero trading-method calls on the wrapped api
commit failure persists the snapshot as pending (never dropped)
task stays RAW_VERIFIED (no checkpoint advance)
run terminal RECOVERY_REQUIRED, exit code 5
bounded queue full pauses NEW tasks and records backpressure
no unconfirmed data dropped; after drain the run finalizes honestly
broken OHLC rows classify INVALID with reasons; NaN head rows PADDING
frame = padding + invalid + valid conserved; requested=8192 counted independently of returned
daily rows without calendar session-end stay row_status UNKNOWN
requested window below min returned first-nano yields OUTSIDE_FREE_WINDOW gap evidence
